name: Rane (Madras) Limited
summary: Rane (Madras) Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of auto components for transportation industry in India and internationally. It offers steering and suspension systems, linkage products, steering gears, aluminum high pressure die-casting products, brake components, and engine components. The company markets and sells its products to the manufacturers of passenger cars, utility vehicles, and farm tractors. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Chennai, India. Rane (Madras) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Rane Holdings Limited.
